metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear Valorant paused to ask ‘Are you sure?’ LOL
metadata.description:
I didn’t even line up the shot, and somehow it connected.
Enemy probably uninstalling just to rethink their life choices.
Click if your luck ever did the aiming for you!
Watch me pretend this was all on purpose.

Tap if your aim’s broke but the game still loves you!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
